stream.name: stream
stream.description: Linear payment streaming with optional cliff, batch creation, protocol fee, and recipient transfer. Source of truth: contracts/stream/src/lib.rs.

entryPoints.name: initialize
entryPoints.description: One-time setup of the protocol admin, treasury, and fee (in basis points, capped at 10%).

auth.notes: admin must sign; a second call fails with AlreadyInitialized.

paths.description: Admin, treasury, and fee stored; instance TTL bumped.
paths.postcondition: DataKey::Admin, DataKey::Treasury, DataKey::Fee written; instance TTL extended.

paths.description: Contract has already been initialized.
fee_bps exceeds the 10% cap (1000 BPS).
paths.retryNotes: Retry with fee_bps <= 1000.

paths.description: Missing or wrong admin signature.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with a correctly signed transaction.

entryPoints.name: create_stream
entryPoints.description: Lock tokens for a single linear vesting stream. The contract assigns an auto-incrementing id.

args.name: start_time
args.description: Unix seconds; must be >= current ledger timestamp.

args.name: cliff_time
args.description: Unix seconds; must be in [start_time, end_time].

entryPoints.returns: Result<u64, StreamError> — the new stream id

paths.description: Stream created; tokens transferred sender → contract; id returned.
paths.precondition: amount > 0, start_time >= now, end_time > start_time, cliff in range, metadata within length limits
paths.postcondition: Stream stored under new id; next_stream_id incremented; sender balance reduced by amount.

paths.description: amount is zero or negative.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with amount > 0.

paths.description: end_time <= start_time.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with end_time > start_time.

paths.description: cliff_time outside [start_time, end_time].
paths.retryNotes: Retry with start_time <= cliff_time <= end_time.

paths.description: start_time is before the current ledger timestamp.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with start_time >= current ledger timestamp. start_time equal to now is accepted.

paths.description: label or reference exceeds byte-length cap.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with label <= 64 bytes and reference <= 128 bytes.

paths.description: sender.require_auth() fails (missing or wrong signature).
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with a valid sender signature.

entryPoints.name: create_streams
entryPoints.description: Batch-create up to MAX_BATCH (14) streams in a single all-or-nothing transaction. sender funds every stream and signs once. Streams store empty label and reference strings.

args.name: entries
args.description: Each tuple is (recipient, amount, start_time, cliff_time, end_time). Note cliff precedes end, unlike create_stream's argument order.

entryPoints.returns: Result<Vec<u64>, StreamError> — ids in input order

paths.description: All entries valid; total deposit transferred; each stream stored; ids returned in input order.
paths.precondition: 1 <= len(entries) <= 14; all individual validations pass; sum of amounts < i128::MAX; id range does not overflow u64.
paths.postcondition: N streams stored; next_stream_id advanced by N; one created event per stream.

paths.description: entries is empty.
paths.retryNotes: Provide at least one entry.

paths.description: entries has more than 14 items.
paths.retryNotes: Split into batches of at most 14.

paths.description: Sum of amounts overflows i128, or the resulting id range overflows u64.
paths.retryNotes: Reduce total amount or split into smaller batches.

paths.description: One or more entries fail per-stream validation (amount, time range, cliff, start_time). No streams are created.
paths.errorVariant: One of InvalidAmount(1), InvalidTimeRange(2), InvalidCliff(3), InvalidStartTime(12)
paths.retryNotes: Fix the failing entry and resubmit. next_stream_id is unchanged.

paths.description: Soroban RPC returns a timeout or HTTP 503 before the transaction is confirmed.
paths.retryNotes: Query next_stream_id before retrying. If it has advanced by the batch size the original transaction landed; do not resubmit.

entryPoints.name: withdraw
entryPoints.description: Recipient claims all currently vested and unclaimed tokens, net of the protocol fee (if configured).
entryPoints.returns: Result<i128, StreamError> — net amount paid to recipient after fee

auth.actor: recipient (the address stored on the stream)

paths.description: Claimable amount transferred to recipient; fee (if any) transferred to treasury; withdrawn counter updated.
paths.precondition: stream exists; vested(now) - withdrawn > 0; treasury set if fee_bps > 0
paths.postcondition: stream.withdrawn increased; recipient balance increased by net amount; treasury balance increased by fee.

paths.description: stream_id does not exist or its persistent entry has expired.
Nothing has vested yet (before cliff, fully withdrawn, or amount is 0).
paths.retryNotes: Retry after cliff_time or when more of the schedule elapses.

paths.description: fee_bps is non-zero but no treasury address is stored.
paths.retryNotes: Protocol admin must call set_treasury before any fee-bearing withdrawal.

paths.description: Caller is not the stored recipient.
paths.errorVariant: Soroban Context error (require_auth on stored recipient, not caller arg)
paths.retryNotes: Only the stream's recipient address can call withdraw.

paths.description: RPC timeout after submission. The transaction may or may not have landed.
paths.retryNotes: Check stream.withdrawn on-chain before resubmitting to avoid a double-submit that returns NothingToWithdraw.

entryPoints.name: cancel
entryPoints.description: Sender cancels an active stream. Unvested tokens return to sender; vested-but-unclaimed tokens remain withdrawable by recipient.

paths.description: Unvested tokens refunded to sender; stream times collapsed to now so the vested remainder is still withdrawable by recipient.
paths.postcondition: stream.cancelled = true; stream.total_amount = vested(now); start/end/cliff times = now; sender receives unvested portion.

paths.description: Stream does not exist.
Stream was already cancelled.
Only stream.sender may cancel.
paths.retryNotes: Submit with the original sender's signature.

entryPoints.name: transfer_recipient
entryPoints.description: Current recipient hands the stream to a new address (key rotation, sale). The new recipient inherits all unclaimed vested tokens.

args.name: caller
args.description: Must be the current recipient. Signed explicitly to avoid host-level auth traps.

auth.notes: An explicit caller arg is compared against stream.recipient so a mismatch produces SameRecipient or Unauthorized rather than a host trap.

paths.description: stream.recipient updated to new_recipient; withdrawn/schedule untouched. Works on cancelled streams to allow claiming residual vested balance.
paths.precondition: stream exists; caller == stream.recipient; new_recipient != stream.recipient

paths.description: new_recipient is the same as the current recipient.
paths.retryNotes: Provide a different new_recipient address.

paths.description: Stream does not exist.
caller is not the stored recipient (checked after require_auth).
paths.retryNotes: Submit with the actual current recipient's signature.

errorCodes.meaning: amount <= 0 in create_stream or a create_streams entry.
No stream under stream_id; may also mean a persistent entry lapsed its TTL.
transfer_recipient caller is not the stored recipient. set_fee/set_treasury called without an initialized admin.
cancel called on a stream with cancelled == true.
withdraw called when fee_bps > 0 but no treasury address is stored.
Sum of batch amounts overflows i128, or id range overflows u64.

events.notes: One event per stream. For create_streams, events are emitted in input order.
amount is the net recipient received; fee is what the treasury received. amount + fee = gross claimable.
refunded is the unvested portion returned to sender. Recipient's remaining vested amount is still to be withdrawn.

states.name: active
states.description: Stream exists, not cancelled, within or before its schedule.

states.name: completed
states.description: end_time has passed and all tokens have been withdrawn.

splits.name: splits
splits.description: Immutable proportional payment splits. Anyone may pay into a registered split and tokens distribute immediately. Source of truth: contracts/splits/src/lib.rs.

entryPoints.name: create_split
entryPoints.description: Register a new split with a list of recipients and their proportional shares (weights, not percentages).

args.name: shares
args.description: Weights; must be same length as recipients, all > 0, no duplicates, sum <= u32::MAX.

entryPoints.returns: Result<u64, SplitError> — the new split id

paths.description: Split stored; id assigned from NextId counter; id returned.
paths.postcondition: Split stored under new id; next_split_id incremented.

paths.description: recipients is empty.
paths.retryNotes: Provide at least one recipient.

paths.description: shares.len() != recipients.len().
Any share is 0.
paths.retryNotes: All shares must be >= 1.

paths.description: An address appears more than once in recipients.
paths.retryNotes: Remove duplicate addresses.

paths.description: Sum of all shares overflows u32::MAX.
paths.retryNotes: Reduce share values so the total stays within u32::MAX.

entryPoints.name: distribute
entryPoints.description: Pay amount of token into a split. Tokens are distributed to recipients proportionally in a single transaction. The final recipient absorbs rounding dust.

auth.notes: InvalidAmount is checked before require_auth so an amount validation failure does not trigger a wallet prompt.

paths.description: 1 + N token transfers (from → contract, contract → each recipient). Final recipient absorbs dust.
paths.postcondition: Each recipient's balance increased by their proportional share; from's balance reduced by amount.

paths.description: amount <= 0. Checked before auth and split lookup.
split_id not found or its persistent entry expired.
from.require_auth() fails.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with from's valid signature.

paths.description: RPC timeout after submission.
paths.retryNotes: Check from's balance and each recipient's balance to determine if the transaction landed before resubmitting.

errorCodes.meaning: create_split with an empty recipients list.
An address appears more than once in recipients.
split_id unregistered or its persistent entry has expired.
Defined but never returned by this contract.
Sum of all shares exceeds u32::MAX.

events.notes: Topic symbol is 'distrib' (9 chars max). One event per distribute call even though N+1 token transfers occur.

states.name: registered
states.description: Split stored; can receive payments indefinitely. No terminal state — splits are immutable once created.

transitions.tokenTransfer: from → contract (amount), then contract → each recipient

escrow.name: escrow
escrow.description: Three-party (payer, payee, arbiter) escrow with deadline-driven cancellation and optional milestone schedule. Source of truth: contracts/escrow/src/lib.rs.

entryPoints.name: create_escrow
entryPoints.description: Create a new escrow agreement. The contract auto-assigns the id from an instance-storage counter.

args.name: deadline
args.description: Unix seconds; must be > current ledger timestamp.

entryPoints.returns: Result<u64, EscrowError> — the new escrow id

paths.description: Escrow stored with status Created; id assigned; NextId counter incremented; instance TTL bumped.
paths.postcondition: Escrow stored under new id with status Created; next_escrow_id incremented.

paths.description: amount <= 0.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with amount > 0. Checked before payer auth.

paths.description: deadline is not in the future.
paths.retryNotes: Retry with deadline > current ledger timestamp.

paths.description: payer.require_auth() fails.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with payer's valid signature.

entryPoints.name: fund_escrow
entryPoints.description: Payer locks tokens into the escrow contract, moving it to Funded state.

paths.description: escrow.amount transferred payer → contract; status becomes Funded.
paths.postcondition: escrow.status = Funded; payer's token balance reduced by amount.

paths.description: Escrow id does not exist.
Escrow is not in Created state (already funded or finalized).
Only escrow.payer may fund.
paths.retryNotes: Submit with the payer's signature.

paths.description: RPC timeout after fund_escrow submission.
paths.retryNotes: Call get_escrow(id) to check status before resubmitting. If status == Funded the original transaction landed.

entryPoints.name: release_escrow
entryPoints.description: Release the full escrowed amount to the payee. Authorized by payer or arbiter. Blocked if a milestone schedule is attached (use release_milestone instead).

args.name: caller
args.description: Must be payer or arbiter; must sign.

auth.notes: caller is an explicit argument compared against stored roles after caller.require_auth() — a mismatch fails with UnauthorizedOperation, not a host trap.

paths.description: Full amount transferred contract → payee; status becomes Released.
paths.precondition: escrow.status == Funded; caller in {payer, arbiter}; no milestone schedule attached
paths.postcondition: escrow.status = Released; payee's balance increased by amount.

paths.description: Escrow not found.
Escrow is not Funded (still Created — tokens not yet locked).
paths.retryNotes: Call fund_escrow first.

paths.description: Escrow is already in a terminal state (Released, Refunded, or Cancelled).
caller is neither payer nor arbiter.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with payer's or arbiter's signature.

entryPoints.name: refund_escrow
entryPoints.description: Refund the remaining amount (total minus already-released milestones) to the payer. Authorized by payee or arbiter.

paths.description: Refundable amount (total minus milestone payouts) returned to payer; status becomes Refunded.
paths.postcondition: escrow.status = Refunded; payer's balance increased by refundable amount.

paths.description: Escrow not in Funded state.
paths.retryNotes: Created → Funded required; Refunded on a Created escrow returns InvalidStateTransition.

paths.description: Escrow already finalized.
caller is neither payee nor arbiter.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with payee's or arbiter's signature.

entryPoints.name: cancel_escrow
entryPoints.description: Payer cancels the escrow. If unfunded (Created), the escrow is dropped with no token transfer. If funded (Funded), cancellation is only possible after the deadline.

paths.description: Created → Cancelled with no token transfer.
Funded → Cancelled after deadline; payer receives remaining funds.
paths.precondition: escrow.status == Funded; ledger.timestamp() >= deadline; caller == payer
paths.postcondition: escrow.status = Cancelled; payer's balance increased by refundable amount.

paths.description: Escrow not found.
Escrow is Funded and the deadline has not yet passed.
paths.retryNotes: Wait until ledger.timestamp() >= escrow.deadline then resubmit.

paths.description: Escrow already in a terminal state.
Only payer may cancel.
paths.retryNotes: Resubmit with escrow.payer's signature.

entryPoints.name: set_milestones
entryPoints.description: Attach a milestone payment schedule to an unfunded escrow. Amounts must all be positive and sum exactly to escrow.amount. Requires at least 2 milestones. Only payer may call.

args.name: amounts
args.description: Must have >= 2 entries; all > 0; sum == escrow.amount.

paths.description: Milestone schedule stored; each milestone starts as unreleased.
paths.precondition: escrow.status == Created; caller == payer; amounts.len() >= 2; all positive; sum == escrow.amount

paths.description: Milestone schedule is invalid (< 2 entries, any entry <= 0, or sum != escrow.amount).
Escrow not in Created state (already funded or finalized).

entryPoints.name: release_milestone
entryPoints.description: Release one milestone share to the payee. Payer or arbiter only. The final milestone sets status to Released.

paths.description: Milestone amount transferred contract → payee; milestone flagged as released. Final milestone sets status to Released.
paths.precondition: escrow.status == Funded; milestone_index in range; milestone not yet released; deadline not passed
paths.postcondition: payee receives milestone amount; milestone flag set; if all released → status = Released.

paths.description: No milestone schedule attached.
milestone_index >= milestones.len().
Milestone at milestone_index already released.
caller is neither payer nor arbiter.

errorCodes.meaning: RETIRED — discriminant reserved but never returned. Creation no longer collides.
In-contract role mismatch after require_auth succeeded.
Transition not allowed from current state.
DEFINED BUT NEVER RETURNED. A passed deadline never locks release/refund.
Escrow is in a terminal state.
release_milestone called but no schedule attached.
Invalid schedule: < 2 entries, any <= 0, or sum != escrow.amount.

events.notes: caller + payee are both present so an indexer can tell who authorized and who received.
No amount field. Fires for both Created→Cancelled (no transfer) and Funded→Cancelled (refund). Read the stored amount or token transfers to determine which case.

states.name: Cancelled
states.description: Escrow cancelled; funds returned to payer if Funded.
